conversation.text: Pardon? Weet u waarom die bus niet stopte?
conversation.translation: Excuse me? Do you know why that bus didn't stop?

conversation.text: Stond u hier op de bus te wachten?
conversation.translation: Were you waiting for the bus here?

conversation.text: Ja, ik stond hier al 10 minuten.
conversation.translation: Yes, I've been standing here for 10 minutes.

conversation.text: Mijn hand? Nee. Moest dat dan?
conversation.translation: My hand? No. Was I supposed to?

conversation.text: Ja, bij deze halte moet u aangeven dat u mee wilt.
conversation.translation: Yes, at this stop you have to signal that you want to get on.

conversation.text: Oh nee, dat wist ik niet.
conversation.translation: Oh no, I didn't know that.

conversation.text: Geen zorgen. De volgende bus komt over 5 minuten.
conversation.translation: Don't worry. The next bus comes in 5 minutes.

conversation.text: Oké, deze keer steek ik twee handen op.
conversation.translation: Okay, this time I'll raise both hands.
